responsibility: This file contains the RTL machine descriptions for the NDS32 DSP extension and vector-like packed operations. It defines move patterns for small vector modes and V2SI, DSP arithmetic, saturation, packing, bit-pick, rounding, widening/extraction, 64-bit DSP shifts, clip/bit-reverse instructions, and associated FPU register transfer variants when DSP vector values share register resources, making it the main instruction-pattern body for extension-specific code generation beyond the baseline ISA.
